title: How ProSourced Works: Find, Compare and Hire Pros
description: How to use ProSourced to find business professionals: choose a service, build a free brief, compare several quotes and check credentials before you hire.
h1: How to find and hire the right professional
intro: ProSourced is a free introduction and comparison service for business services. Here’s how to go from “we need help” to a professional you trust.

image.alt: Laptop showing a video call next to a houseplant

items.title: Choose your service
items.text: Start from a service guide to learn what good looks like and what to ask.

items.title: Build your brief
items.text: Use the free brief builder so every provider quotes for the same thing.

items.title: Compare quotes
items.text: Ask several professionals. Compare scope, approach, timing and price, not just the total.

items.title: Check and hire
items.text: Verify credentials and insurance, take up references and agree everything in writing.

sections.html:
• Credentials: check professional registers. Each service guide lists the main bodies by country.
  • Insurance: professional indemnity (also called errors and omissions) cover for advice-based services.
  • References: speak to two or three clients similar to you.
  • Contract: scope, deliverables, fees, payment terms, ownership of work, confidentiality, data protection and how either side can end it.

Our sister site DomComInsure explains business and professional indemnity insurance.

ProSourced doesn’t employ, endorse or vet individual professionals, and we’re not a party to any agreement you make. Some links are referral links: partner platforms may pay us a fee when we introduce you, at no extra cost to you. How we make money.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay to use ProSourced?
faqs.a: No. ProSourced is free for businesses.

faqs.q: How many quotes should I get?
faqs.a: Two or three is a good rule of thumb for most projects. It’s enough to compare without taking too much of your time.

cardText: Choose a service, build a brief, compare quotes, check credentials and hire.
